sentences.text: Palaeoephippiorhynchus was a large stork that lived in Africa during the Oligocene.
The saddle-billed stork is the closest living relative of Palaeoephippiorhynchus.
The genus Palaeoephippiorhynchus was described by Lambrecht in 1930.
Only one fossil occurrence of Palaeoephippiorhynchus has been recorded.
Palaeoephippiorhynchus belongs to the family Ciconiidae.
Fossils of Palaeoephippiorhynchus date to the Oligocene epoch.
The species lived between 33.9 and 27.3 million years ago during the Rupelian stage.
